Education arm of NetDragon Websoft, the Chinese online-games company. Chinese online learning platform founded in Shanghai in 2001 as a language-learning community. US adaptive learning technology company founded in 2008 by Jose Ferreira. Chinese online recruitment platform focused on internet and technology jobs, launched in Beijing around 2013. Beijing-based flexible office and coworking operator (known in Chinese as Mengxiang Jia) founded around 2014. Wind turbine developer and manufacturer, originally from Vermont, known for its direct-drive permanent-magnet turbines in the 100 kilowatt class for community and distributed wind projects. Chinese online post-secondary education provider listed on the New York Stock Exchange (STG) since 2018. Italian infrastructure group controlling toll motorways, notably the Turin-Milan and other northern Italian routes, and involved in engineering, construction and concessions through its subsidiaries, with historic ties to the Gavio family. UK structural steel group, listed on the London Stock Exchange (SFR), supplier of steelwork to major projects including The Shard, Wembley Stadium and London data centres. Swedish discount retailer of building materials and home improvement products, listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. Software company (ASX: LVT) that sells intelligent workplace products built on Microsoft platforms, including the LiveTiles design tool for intranets and digital workplaces, bots and analytics products. Polish construction and property group, listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange. Chinese online game developer and publisher, listed in Hong Kong (0777), founded in Fuzhou by Dejian Liu. US maker of resilient flooring: luxury vinyl tile, vinyl sheet, linoleum, laminate and wood, sold under the Armstrong Flooring brand to homebuilders, contractors and home centres in North America. Canadian junior mining company exploring for gold and silver, centred on the Lawyers-Ranch project in northern British Columbia, listed on the TSX Venture Exchange. Australian clean energy technology developer, listed on the ASX, best known for CETO, a wave-energy technology that converts ocean swell into power and desalinated water, trialled off Garden Island near Perth. Small cap with a government and project-based funding model. Little consumer awareness.

West African gold producer headquartered in the UK with operations in Mali and Guinea. US cannabis technology company providing the Dutchie platform used by dispensaries for online ordering, e-commerce, point of sale, payments and a marketplace for shoppers. South Korean battery materials maker producing electrolytic copper foil used in lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles and electronics. Israeli digital printing company founded by Benny Landa, who also founded Indigo (sold to HP). Swedish cable TV, broadband and telephony provider, serving roughly 1.7 million households with fast internet over its coaxial and fibre network, digital TV and play-on-demand services such as Com Hem Play. UK government department created in February 2023, which took over digital, science and technology responsibilities. Canadian gold producer listed on the TSX and NYSE (AGI), operating mines including Young-Davidson and Island Gold in Ontario, Mulatos in Mexico, and Kirazlı in Turkey, with the Lynx and Magino projects added. US healthcare company (Nasdaq: ASTH), formerly Apollo Medical Holdings, that manages risk-bearing physician networks and value-based care. Gold mining company that owns the Asanko Gold Mine in Ghana's Ashanti region, a producer with several open pits and a processing plant of about five million tonnes a year, listed on the TSX and NYSE American (GAU). US addiction treatment provider offering residential detox, rehab and outpatient services under a continuum-of-care model across Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware, Maryland and the Mid-Atlantic, with roughly a dozen treatment centres. Regional healthcare provider with local advertising and reputation but limited national brand awareness.

Ecuadorian shrimp farming and processing business, one of the country's larger exporters of farmed white shrimp, which is a staple export of Ecuador alongside bananas. Chinese online steel trading platform (Zhaogang) founded in 2012 in Shanghai.
